name: Chalice Chapel
introDiscord:
A small royal chapel is filled with floating ceremonial cups.

Several are simply cups.

Several are Jellyfish wearing cups.

Nobody explains this.
introTwitch:
A small royal chapel is filled with floating ceremonial cups.

Several are simply cups.

Several are Jellyfish wearing cups.

Nobody explains this.

chalice-chapel-approach.prompt: Chalice Chapel opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message:
A genuine chalice contains Star Candies.

Refreshing concept.

right.message:
Restorative water fills a ceremonial basin.

Shizuki's note:

'Did not drink random royal cup.

Character growth.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message:
A chalice floats upward.

Tentacles emerge underneath.

Character growth immediately rewarded.

chalice-chapel-depths.prompt: Deeper within Chalice Chapel, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message: A Chalice Jelly glides from behind the altar.

right.message:
One Berry rests inside a tiny cup.

Shizuki wrote:

'Berry communion.

Religious significance:

none.

Snack significance:

high.'

forward.message: A chapel offering box contains Star Candies.

chalice-chapel-threshold.prompt: Near Sunken Communion, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message: A sealed reliquary contains Star Candies.

right.message: A Chalice Jelly blocks the final aisle.

forward.message:
Shizuki's bottle:

'Definitely medicine.

Not ceremonial mystery liquid.

Checked.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

boss-antechamber.name: Sunken Communion
boss-antechamber.prompt: Every floating chalice rises toward the chapel ceiling.

bossPromptDiscord:
Every floating chalice rises toward the chapel ceiling.

One enormous bell-shaped figure descends beneath them.

Use /yes to enter Sunken Communion or /no to maintain a
healthy skepticism toward religious tableware.
bossPromptTwitch:
Every floating chalice rises toward the chapel ceiling.

One enormous bell-shaped figure descends beneath them.

Use !yes to enter Sunken Communion or !no to maintain a
healthy skepticism toward religious tableware.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Sunken Communion. The royal challenge will wait.
completionText:
The chapel grows quiet.

One chalice lands upright.

Still just a cup.

Probably.
